# IKE Working-Set Leases

> Single-writer working-set leases across Syncthing-paired machines:
> the protocol and materializer core (a plain-Java library the ws:
> goals can consume), and the IntelliJ enforcement plugin that hosts
> it at the open gesture. Split per IKE-Network/ike-issues#1067.

## Documentation

- [IKE Working-Set Leases](https://ike.network/ike-base-parent/ike-lease/index.html.md)
